caption: This orange-brown, glossy miso broth with visible noodles and toppings sits in a white ceramic bowl with red geometric pattern and blue "ARASAKI" text. On top are dark green nori, pinkish chashu pork with white marbling, and golden-brown menma, all set on a warm brown wooden table with grain patterns.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows pinkish meat with white marbling, slightly curled edge, and glossy surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface with visible veins.
The miso broth is orange-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and toppings.
Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, slightly glossy, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and blue "ARASAKI" text on its rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
